reading.title: The Discovery of Exoplanets
reading.passage: The discovery of exoplanets has revolutionized astronomy by revealing that planetary systems exist beyond our solar system. Since 1995, astronomers have identified over 5,000 exoplanets using various detection methods, including the transit method and radial velocity technique. These discoveries suggest that planets are common throughout the universe. Some exoplanets exist in habitable zones where conditions might support life. This finding fundamentally challenges our understanding of our place in the cosmos and raises profound questions about extraterrestrial life.

questions.q: According to the passage, how many exoplanets have been identified since 1995?
options: A. Over 1,000
B. Over 5,000
C. Over 10,000
D. Over 50,000
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '1995년 이후 5,000개 이상의 외계행성이 발견되었다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about planetary systems in the universe?
options: A. They are extremely rare and unique to our galaxy
B. They only exist in habitable zones
C. They are common throughout the universe
D. They cannot support any form of life
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '이러한 발견은 행성이 우주 전역에서 흔하다는 것을 제시한다'고 설명하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Countries should implement stricter immigration policies to control population growth and protect local job markets. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 도입부 작성 가이드: 이민 정책에 대한 입장을 명확히 하되, 찬성/반대 입장을 분명히 표현하세요. 예시: 'In my opinion, I believe that immigration policies should be carefully balanced rather than simply made stricter, as both immigration and local protection have merit.'
structure.body1: 본론 1 아이디어 힌트: 인구 증가 제어의 필요성 vs 문화적 다양성의 이점. 예를 들어, '이민자는 새로운 기술과 관점을 가져오며, 인구 고령화 문제를 해결할 수 있다'는 구체적 사례 제시
structure.body2: 본론 2 아이디어 힌트: 일자리 시장 보호 vs 경제적 성장. 구체 사례로 '캐나다는 선별적 이민 정책을 통해 경제 성장과 고용 창출의 균형을 맞추었다'는 예시 활용
structure.conclusion: 결론 작성 가이드: 주장을 재진술하면서, '효과적인 이민 정책은 절대적 제한이 아닌 현명한 관리와 투자'임을 강조하세요.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to shop online for convenience and variety. Others prefer to shop in physical stores to see and touch products before buying. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details in your response.
sample_points: 온라인 쇼핑의 편의성: 시간 절약, 배송 서비스, 가격 비교 용이 - 예시: 바쁜 직장인이 야밤에 쇼핑 가능
매장 쇼핑의 장점: 제품 직접 확인, 즉시 구매 가능, 반품 편리성 - 예시: 옷의 핏이나 색상을 직접 확인
결론: 두 방식의 균형잡힌 활용이 최선임을 제시

listening.title: Dormitory Room Assignment Request
listening.script:
Student A: Hi, I'm calling about my dormitory room assignment. I submitted my housing application three weeks ago, but I haven't received confirmation yet.

Receptionist: I understand your concern. Let me pull up your information. Can you provide your student ID number?

Student A: Sure, it's 20240567.

Receptionist: Thank you. I see your application here. According to our records, your request was received on time. However, due to high demand this semester, room assignments are taking longer than usual. We typically send confirmations by email within five business days.

Student A: Oh, I see. Is there anything I can do to speed up the process? I'm an international student, and I need to finalize my housing before my visa interview.

Receptionist: I completely understand. Let me check if I can expedite your case. Since you're an international student, you qualify for priority processing. I'll make a note here and forward your file to the housing coordinator. You should receive your assignment within 48 hours.

Student A: That's great! Thank you so much. Is there a specific email address I should check?

Receptionist: You'll receive it at your university email address on file. If you don't hear from us by tomorrow evening, feel free to call back and ask for me.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: A. Visa interview procedures
B. Dormitory room assignment inquiry
C. International student orientation
D. Housing application deadlines
questions.explanation: 학생이 기숙사 배정 확인에 대해 문의하는 것이 대화의 주요 내용입니다.

questions.q: Why is the student requesting expedited processing?
options: A. He is dissatisfied with the housing options
B. He needs finalization before his visa interview
C. He submitted his application late
D. He wants to change his dormitory assignment
questions.explanation: 학생은 비자 인터뷰 전에 주택을 확정해야 하기 때문에 빠른 처리를 요청했습니다.

questions.q: What does the receptionist suggest about the student's status?
options: A. International students cannot receive priority processing
B. International students have delayed application deadlines
C. International students qualify for priority processing
D. International students must pay an additional fee
questions.explanation: 직원은 유학생 신분으로 인해 우선 처리 대상이 된다고 언급했습니다.
